decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block that shares firmware, bindings and production with the rest of the platform, so holding the option costs little while its demand is still emerging.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and supports the firm's move into industrial automation and energy management, which justifies keeping this low-cost option open.
The solid state relay module extends the established relay range with minimal carrying cost, and nothing yet shows its value will not be realized.
The server room kit only bundles existing modules and is cheap to keep, though as a kit it remains the easiest option to drop if the platform's connector migration makes it obsolete.
The RGB LED control module was launched only in 2024 on the modular platform, so its uncertainty is unresolved and keeping it costs very little.
The wallbox remote access service supports the firm's strategic expansion of charging and energy management and adds value to the installed charger base, making it an option worth keeping.
